methodology: Curated list of widely-recognized National Universities (US) and Liberal Arts Colleges, extended with a verified T50 Ivy+/T20/state-flagship set, plus notable non-US institutions with existing sourced rankings (QS/NIRF) in canonical.institution_rankings. Institution NAMES only are reproduced here (factual, not copyrightable) -- no proprietary ranking numbers/order from any single publisher (e.g. US News) are used. Each name was resolved against canonical.institutions by exact name match after a merge/enrichment pass (see docs/data_audit_2026-07-16.md Phase 2) that fixed 50 duplicate master-row/Scorecard-row pairs and attached verified IPEDS ids to 5 more (Northwestern, Cornell, Boston College, Idaho, UCF) that had no DB duplicate at all.
